title: LLM-Driven Algorithm Design for Quantum Circuit Synthesis based on Binary Decision Diagrams
abstract: arXiv:2609.05327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum circuits are central to implementing quantum algorithms on quantum devices, where quantum gates must be reversible. Many quantum algorithms rely on Boolean functions, which must therefore be implemented reversibly within quantum circuits. Reversible circuit synthesis provides a way to translate such Boolean functions into reversible circuits. Binary decision diagrams (BDDs) offer a scalable approach to this task, but the resulting BDDs and circuits depend heavily on variable ordering. Existing ordering heuristics commonly minimize BDD size because it is closely tied to the circuit size. However, BDD size is an imperfect proxy for the quantum cost of the synthesized circuit (QCC). We propose \texttt{QuantumEvo}, an evolutionary framework that uses an LLM as a heuristic generator for QCC-aware BDD variable ordering. translated_title: 基于二元决策图的量子电路综合的LLM驱动算法设计
translated_abstract: 量子电路是在量子设备上实现量子算法的核心，其中量子门必须是可逆的。许多量子算法依赖于布尔函数，因此这些布尔函数必须在量子电路中以可逆方式实现。可逆电路综合提供了一种将此类布尔函数转换为可逆电路的方法。二元决策图为此任务提供了一种可扩展的途径，但所得的BDD和电路在很大程度上取决于变量排序。现有的排序启发式方法通常以最小化BDD大小为目标，因为BDD大小与电路规模密切相关。然而，BDD大小只是合成电路量子成本（QCC）的一个并不完美的代理指标。我们提出了QuantumEvo，这是一个进化框架，它使用大语言模型（LLM）作为启发式生成器，用于面向量子成本的BDD变量排序。QuantumEvo并不直接预测排序，而是在从多元初始化的排序启发式空间中进行搜索……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出QuantumEvo进化框架，利用大语言模型作为启发式生成器来搜索面向量子电路成本（而非仅最小化BDD大小）的BDD变量排序启发式，从而提升可逆量子电路综合的质量。
en_tdlr: QuantumEvo is an evolutionary framework that uses an LLM as a heuristic generator to search for BDD variable-ordering heuristics optimized for the quantum cost of the synthesized circuit, rather than merely minimizing BDD size, thereby improving reversible quantum circuit synthesis.
